messages:
ravi: Heads up — fantasy semis tonight. Who's bringing snacks?

kelly: I can bring pretzels and two sodas.

otto: I'll toss in an emergency hot sauce stash. Also: coinflip for roster tie? :coin:

score-bot: LeagueBot: Reminder - Semifinal waiver freeze at 8:30pm.

ina: Count me in for the coinflip. I still owe @ravi a rematch from last year.

ben: Quick poll: office watch or stream at desks? I vote lounge for vibes.

ravi: Lounge works if someone can collect $3 for pizza + tip. I'll handle ordering.

kelly: In for $3. Also bonus points if someone brings nacho cheese.

otto: Nacho cheese secured. I will also volunteer 10 mins for cleanup.

nina: If the match goes OT, I buy coffee tomorrow for the office. Stakes set.

ben: Love it. See you all at kickoff. Low stakes gambling, high morale. :raised_hands:
